ig_fmla_c334ab_01.desc: Should the federal government guarantee paid family and medical leave for workers?

ig_fmla_c334ab_02.desc: Why should taking time off to care for a newborn mean losing a large part of your income?

ig_fmla_c334ab_03.desc: Should every worker have access to paid parental leave regardless of where they live?

ig_fmla_c334ab_04.desc: Would a national paid family leave program make it easier for new parents to stay financially stable?

ig_fmla_c334ab_05.desc: Should paid leave cover caring for sick parents and spouses as well as caring for children?

ig_fmla_c334ab_06.desc: How many weeks of paid family leave should the federal government guarantee?

ig_fmla_c334ab_07.desc: Should paid leave replace 100% of a worker's wages or only a portion of them?

ig_fmla_c334ab_08.desc: Who should pay for a national paid family leave program: employers, workers, taxpayers, or some combination?

ig_fmla_c334ab_09.desc: Would paid family leave help small businesses compete for workers, or would the costs be too high?

ig_fmla_c334ab_10.desc: Should workers be guaranteed job protection when they take paid family leave?

ig_fmla_c334ab_11.desc: Why does access to paid family leave vary so much depending on which state someone lives in?

ig_fmla_c334ab_12.desc: Should the federal government create a nationwide minimum standard while allowing states to provide more generous benefits?

ig_fmla_c334ab_13.desc: Would paid parental leave encourage more people to return to work after having children?

ig_fmla_c334ab_14.desc: Should family leave include time to care for an elderly parent or seriously ill family member?

ig_fmla_c334ab_15.desc: Could a national paid leave program reduce the financial pressure on families after a major life event?

ig_fmla_c334ab_16.desc: Should part-time and lower-wage workers receive the same paid leave protections as full-time employees?

ig_fmla_c334ab_17.desc: Would payroll taxes be an acceptable way to fund a national paid family leave program?

ig_fmla_c334ab_18.desc: Should employers receive tax credits for offering paid family and medical leave?

ig_fmla_c334ab_19.desc: Is unpaid, job-protected FMLA enough, or should federal law require paid leave as well?

ig_fmla_c334ab_20.desc: Should paid family leave be designed as an insurance program rather than a direct employer benefit?
